The person is wearing EXACTLY these five items, all clearly visible, nothing else added:
1) a lightweight olive-green quilted puffer jacket with a matte nylon shell, horizontal baffles, stand collar and a hidden front zip under a snap placket, regular hip-length cut, worn open
2) a soft beige melange fine-knit crew-neck sweater with long sleeves and ribbed neckline, cuffs and hem, regular fit

4) dark chocolate-brown suede-look Chelsea boots with elasticated side panels, a pull loop at the back, rounded toe and a low dark rubber sole

One geometric sans-serif font family throughout (Poppins / Montserrat style). Generous whitespace. Render every piece of text EXACTLY as written, spelled correctly, with straight apostrophes; numbers use spaces as thousand separators. No other text, no logos, no brand marks, no watermarks.
